short_description: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.
name: Above Land: Rhapsody

short_description: A horror survival game where you roam cornfields with a flamethrower, burning scarecrows to claim the land for your crows. Set everything on fire, stay one step ahead, and clear the way so your crows can enjoy the sweet corn. The scarecrows: guardians of the field, won’t go down easy. 🔥
name: Caller of the Crows

short_description: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!
name: Stick N' Sheep

short_description: Explore dangerous bunkers packed with mutants, scavenge vital loot, and race against dwindling oxygen. Upgrade your shelter, craft gear, and risk it all for bigger rewards. Solo or co-op, see how deep you dare go!
name: Raiders of the Apocalypse

short_description: Wildgate is a PvPvE multiplayer shooter that blends tactical ship-to-ship combat with fast-paced first-person action. Evade deadly environmental hazards, search for powerful weapons and ship upgrades, and be the first crew to escape with the Artifact... or the last crew left flying.
name: Wildgate

short_description: Clover's world is thrown into disarray when it starts to snow during the summer cider festival. A sense of curosity will help clover to understand the mystery behind the changing weather patterns, and through skill and mindful exploration maybe even bring magic to their world.
name: Clover

short_description: Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer hide & seek prop hunt game where deception is key. Play as a Yurei, possessing objects & using abilities, or as a Hunter, relying on instincts & proximity voice chat to track them. With a world full of tricks, surprises & eerie tension, every match is a battle of wits.
name: Yurei Hunt

short_description: This is a cooperative tower defense game for two players. Join forces with your friend, use limited resources to build defense towers and release Magic to fend off waves of oncoming monster hordes!
name: TowerAndMagic

short_description: Out of the Shadows is a 2–4 player online co-op horror escape game. Explore unsettling locations, uncover their stories, solve cooperative and asymmetric puzzles, and survive the hostile inhabitants of places your team was never meant to enter.
name: Out of the Shadows

short_description: Enter a realm of terror in this 4-player co-op horror. Explore a 50-room manor haunted by a demon baby. Experience physics-driven chaos and eerie rituals as secrets unfold in every shadow.
name: HellBorn

short_description: Explore a National Park with up to 3 of your photojournalist friends. Take jobs from top magazine brands, then hit the trail in search of interesting landmarks and goofy creatures to photograph. Use your pay to buy useful items and cosmetics. You’ll be sure to make the front page in a flash!
name: shutterbuds

short_description: Every level brings an interesting puzzle to solve. Place and merge tiles using patterns that you’ll discover along the way. Plan ahead, find optimal solutions, and earn rewards that you’ll use to build your Homestead.
name: Hex Town

short_description: Relive the 90s in this collection of classic Nickelodeon games! GUTS, Rocko's Modern Life, and AAAHH!!! Real Monsters are back.
name: Nickelodeon Splat Pack

short_description: The fate of the captured animals is in your hands. Plan your attacks, outsmart the poachers, and prove that one skilled shooter can make a difference in the fight for wildlife. Are you ready to take the shot?
name: Wild Shot: Animal Savior

short_description: Push your favorite to the top! A simple and fun 3D action game—just keep pushing!
name: hololive GoroGoro Mountain

short_description: No Time to Build is a cooperative casual game with parkour and action elements! Collect logs, avoid cars, trains, and walking bombs, overcome challenges, and build structures within the time limit. Teleports, speed-boosting bushes, and player interactions make every game chaotic and fun!
name: No Time to Build

short_description: A co-op space adventure packed with puzzles and brainteasers at every turn.
name: Bot & Tic

short_description: A Chaotic Medieval Social Deduction Party Game for 3–10 Players. Find the traitor or become a traitor. Use Manor as a weapon itself; throw, hit, arm trap. Convert to a Dagger to hide and eliminate.
name: Forks and Daggers

short_description: Night Kin is an immersive single-player post-apocalyptic survival FPS set in the war-torn ruins of Southeast Europe. Embark on unforgiving expeditions, scavenge for resources, adapt to a ruthless world, and uncover the secrets of a land where myth and modern warfare collide.
name: Night Kin

short_description: Enter the Tavern! Compete in arenas, brawl sports, and tournaments. Customize your look & abilities, socialize, form guilds, capture forts, and climb the leaderboards!
name: Brawlers Tavern

short_description: A strategic, combo-driven twist on checkers! Battle quirky ninjas and their overlord bosses, unleash combos, and dominate the board. A completely fresh take on Checkers in a turn-based strategy game. Coming soon to Steam!
name: Combo Critters: Battle Checkers

short_description: Scarlet Idol is a 3D Chinese folk horror puzzle game featuring a co-op two-player mode. The game integrates various folk cultural elements, including the funeral rituals of the Wu-Yue region, Ghost operas, Mulian operas, the duomin (outcast communities)
name: Scarlet Idol

short_description: Victor’s Test: a trial of supernatural resistance. Guard the museum at night, spot artifact anomalies, and adapt as doors shift—triggering or erasing them. Welcome to Victor’s Test Night: Rêves.
name: Victor's Test Night: REVES

short_description: Only Up: CHAINED is an online multiplayer parkour game where you and your friends must climb obstacles and avoid falling at all costs, one wrong move and it could be back to the start.
name: Only Up: CHAINED

short_description: Vibrant platformer: conquer horror towers and save Sprunki from Black
name: Sprunki Horror Towers

short_description: A Low Poly stylized idle-pasture simulator designed to sit at the bottom of your screen allowing you to work on other tasks while caring for your pasture and animals!
name: Desktop Pasture

short_description: Hunt the bunnies, load the catapult and hurl them… The King demands.
name: Bunny Hurling

short_description: Lost in the woods. Trapped in a cabin. Face wave after wave of undead horrors in this intense 80s-themed zombie survival shooter. Play solo or co-op with up to 4 players, in VR or on PC. Keep the lights on, defend the cabin, and survive the night if you can!
name: Drop Dead: The Cabin

short_description: Save London in a co-op action shooter set in a one-to-one recreation of the city. Battle creatures with real-world weapons, mysterious Flux powers, and anything not bolted down.
name: MVX: London

short_description: Undead Presidents is a chaotic, round-based zombie survival shooter with a satirical twist. Play as infamous world leaders in solo or 8-player co-op, battling undead hordes while uncovering dark conspiracies. Arm yourself with insane weaponry and rewrite history—one zombie at a time.
name: Undead Presidents

short_description: Dive into an intense psychological horror experience with Smile, You’re Being Filmed: Together, the multiplayer version of the game where observation and cooperation are your greatest assets.
name: Smile, you're being filmed together

short_description: Paleolith – a hardcore survival simulator set 40,000 years ago. Hunt, craft primitive tools, build fires, and endure the brutal winter. No technology, no magic – just nature, instincts, and the fight to survive in prehistoric Europe. Will you make it?
name: Paleolith

short_description: Boiiing Boiiing is a physics-based party game up to 4 players in local & ONLINE, where you play as animals that chase each other using pogo sticks and unique powers.
name: Boiiing Boiiing

short_description: You are a professional Bug Squasher. Clients reach out to you with their pest problems, and you'll respond to increasingly challenging infestations. With each successful job, you'll earn money to upgrade and expand your equipment and take on bigger, badder bugs.
name: BugSquash

short_description: Stuck In The Backrooms is a horror multiplayer (1-4) exploration game where players find themselves trapped in a different reality. Solve puzzles and investigate levels while avoiding (OR NOT...) entities. Some things were never meant to be found…
name: Stuck In The Backrooms

short_description: Ever wanted to play Crazy golf from the comfort of your own home.... Well now you can! With 5 Maps To Explore And Complete On Launch! Crazy Golf Party is coming to steam soon and is ideal for casual players that want a fun game to play with friends!
name: Crazy Golf Party

short_description: Project FD combines dungeon extraction games and pixel art to create a new action experience. Explore dungeons discovered in ancient ruins , overcome monsters and traps, complete missions, and acquire loot. If you work together with friends, you can deal with many more threats.
name: Project FD

short_description: A precision co-op platformer where the only obstacle is falling. Bring a friend along and work together as you face the brutal challenges that await you both on this climb! Can you both make it Two the Top?
name: Two the Top

short_description: Anomaly Living is a cooperative horror game for 1-2 players. Only you can help find Leia in this world filled with monsters and anomaly phenomena. Good luck!
name: Anomaly Living

short_description: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.
name: PAW Patrol™: Dino World

short_description: Game genre find hidden objects.
name: How Much Items - Animals

short_description: PEAK is a co-op climbing game where the slightest mistake can spell your doom. Either solo or as a group of lost nature scouts, your only hope of rescue from a mysterious island is to scale the mountain at its center. Do you have what it takes to reach the PEAK?
name: PEAK

short_description: You are a brave sheep who was sent to space by the USSR to test a new spaceship, but it veered off course and crashed on an alien planet! You must travel across strange worlds and fend off enemies to make it back to Earth safely.
name: SPACESHEEP

short_description: Have a companion in your daily work! You won’t forget to drink water and stretch while managing your time with the Pomodoro technique. PomoPet is a cute virtual pet that helps you stay focused and maintain well-being in the office, making your routine more productive and enjoyable!
name: PomoPet

short_description: Survive hell in this Roguelike Deckbuilder that features card battles with an in-depth auto-battler-esque synergy and combo system. Help Bobo, the little penguin, recruit allies and face the many horrors that await him on his journey to save his friends.
name: Bobo in Hell

short_description: <Waste Force> is a post-apocalyptic PvE extraction shooter. Drive a garbage truck with your crew and survive oncoming mutants and scavengers. Repair the vehicle during chases and collect resources. Connect special trailers to complete your own vehicle. Cleanse the surface as part of Waste Force!
name: Waste Force

short_description: A fast-paced 4-player cooperative puzzle game where your success helps your teammate, not yourself. Solve memory challenges, pattern recognition tasks, and coordination puzzles under time pressure—but the points you earn go to the player next to you. Trust your team or watch everyone fail.
name: Dependium

short_description: Fixing the Apocalypse is an RPG and Micro-Management game where your decisions shape the story and the ending. It also features turn-based strategic battles, allowing you to lead your forces. There are no right decisions here only yours. ARE YOU READY TO BE THE PRESIDENT?
name: Fixing The Apocalypse

short_description: In this game, you'll explore 50 colorful illustrations featuring adorable pets and challenge yourself to find between 3 and 10 differences in each picture.
name: Mirror Quest Dog and Cat

short_description: Pecking Order is a 16-player online physics-based party game where you eat your friends.
name: Pecking Order

short_description: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.
name: Staged

short_description: You are yokai hunters venturing into cursed lands from which no one returns. Assemble your team, choose your class, and attempt to banish ancient evil in dark feudal Japan. Survive — or become part of the legend.
name: YOKAI WAIFU HUNTERS

short_description: A social deduction game playable with 4–10 players. While the Witch tries to survive, the Judge attempts to hunt her down. Use your persuasion skills, mislead your opponents, and become the winning side.
name: Hunt Up!

short_description: Ogrüuk is a 3D platformer stealth game where ogres have captured all your dogs! You must save them before their cooking pot is at the right temperature! Sneak between monsters and keep away from their lights or you'll also be their dinner!
name: Ogrüuk

short_description: Carve out a place for yourself in an ever changing field of space as you upgrade your bases, and equip your ships to thrive in the mysterious expanse. Build, fight, and align with (or sabotage) neighboring factions.
name: Stellar Drift

short_description: You draw left and right. Your friend draws up and down. Good luck.
name: Doodle Duo

short_description: In "Descent Into Darkness", you must take an elevator down into the depths of a mysterious underground complex, filled with dangers and secrets. Your goal is to find a way out—but with each level, the darkness grows, and the threats become more terrifying...
name: Descent Into Darkness

short_description: In this co-op horror strategy game, you will be a monster breeder in a dystopian world. Capture monsters, feed them, sell their products. Explore multiple maps in Blackchapel to catch more dangerous monsters that bring in more money, to finally escape this infernal city…
name: Blackchapel

short_description: ANLG_VOID is an intense horror exploration game set in the endless, shifting labyrinth of the Backrooms. Built in Unreal Engine 5.5, it delivers an eerie, lore-accurate experience where flickering lights, distant echoes, and shifting hallways fuel your paranoia. You were never meant to be here.
name: ANLG_VOID™

short_description: Vampire’s Castle is a 4-player online co-op horror game. Lured by the promise of treasure, you and your team must explore a cursed fortress while avoiding Vlad, the terrifying Dracula. As a bat, he hears. As a man, he sees. Move carefully, collect valuables, and survive—or face the consequences.
name: Vampire's Castle

short_description: Explore the world through the eyes of a homeless scavenger, rummaging through junkyards, outsmarting security, and turning trash into cash. Play solo or in chaotic multiplayer, where quick hands, smart moves, and a good sense of humor make all the difference. Laugh, hustle, and survive!
name: Trash Trek Simulator

short_description: Carrier Cuties fast-paced 3D arena fighting game where Pets in Hu-Mechs battle in highly interactive and destructible environments using the surroundings to fight. Battle with a partner against two opponents to win all the glory and treats!
name: Carrier Cuties - Pets In Mechs!

short_description: Jitter turns Twitch streams into fully interactive, Twitch-integrated gaming experiences — where thousands of players can jump in at the same time! Viewers don't just watch, they play, with the ability to control the action right from Twitch chat.
name: Jitter Games

short_description: All Those Who Wander is a peaceful exploration and art-making game set in a vast, forgotten landscape. Gather materials and creating stunning environmental installations. No enemies, no rush—just your creativity and the freedom to get lost in a world that rewards those who take the scenic route.
name: All Those Who Wander

short_description: Escape Haunted Mansion is a horrific multiplayer deduction game for 3 to 10 players with voice chat. The Haunteds must complete tasks to escape, while the Cursed seek to eliminate them discreetly.
name: Escape Haunted Mansion

short_description: Hop on kayaks and boats for a fun adventure with up to 8 friends! Work together to paddle through cool waters, overcome obstacles and bosses, and reach new islands. If the legend is true, a hidden treasure awaits on the final island. Can you make it without sinking?
name: Boat Together

short_description: Fight through Purgatory in a janky adventure where you and your friends are ethereally chained together. Wield chain magic, bully enemies with chain physics, and make terrible decisions in this game full of gratuitous amounts of jiggle physics. Built by a solo dev when mom wasn't home.
name: Soul Chained

short_description: Seven Sinners is a western roguelike with turn-based QTE combat. Guide a band of outlaws from the Wild West. Recruit new sinners into your gang, rob stagecoaches and banks, roam the prairies, and evade the sheriff and his hounds. Will you get rich or will you disappear in the prairies?
name: Seven Sinners

short_description: Space Dingus is a co-op horror road trip, in SPACE! Manage your ship, lead a crew full of jerks, and explore a dangerous galaxy in a last-ditch effort to save your home. Every run is randomized, with new stories, characters, and events each time you play. From the team behind Death Road to Canada!
name: Space Dingus

short_description: A co-op horror game where you and a small crew pilot tanks to eradicate the monster infestation plaguing the world. Work together and harness ancient technology to end the scourge once and for all.
name: Ironclad

short_description: A Chaotic co-op adventure about building Makeshift Vehicles to solve puzzles and go Home. Team up with friends and build wild vehicles.
name: MakeShift Mayhem

short_description: Experience a visually immersive survival horror adventure designed for 1-6 player co-op on Unreal Engine 5. Venture through lore-accurate levels, solve intricate puzzles, and evade unpredictable entities. Your only chance of survival is to escape ḯ̵̀f̴͛̔ ̴̪͗y̷̒͜o̷̝͒ư̴͌ ̸̀can
name: Backrooms: Liminal Nightmare

short_description: Coop action horror game where up to 4 players explore, forage, and hunt for food within the dangerous environment of a Bio-Cube. Collect as much food as you can as fast as you can without becoming food yourself.
name: Hell Moon Harvest

short_description: Unleash the chaos! Smash, bash, and crash through everything—and everyone—in sight. From wrecking houses to sabotaging dance-offs, Everyone has a favor to ask. Is he a good boy or a public menace? One thing’s for sure—this is Service Dog
name: Service Dog

short_description: Northwick; The main protagonist Chris uncovers an ancient book contained within are relentless horrors. Each night Chris's understanding of the true evil that has been thrust upon him will deepen. Will you have to commit the ultimate sacrifice?
name: Northwick

short_description: Travel to a forgotten world and study alien creatures in this authentic retro metroidvania!
name: Cosmobreeder Yiffai

short_description: A cozy online co-op digging game for 1-4 friends. Dig a hole in your sunny backyard, find ore and lost blueprints, craft lovely things in your workshop and ship them to customers around the world, who write back with letters and photos. No timers. Just dig.
name: DIG

short_description: Dog Witch is a roguelike deckbuilder where your spells are fueled by enchanted dice. Combine over 150 unique items to forge ever-evolving strategies, perfect synergy combos, summon minions, and tackle an endless range of foes so bizarre, they’ll leave your tail wagging in disbelief!
name: DOG WITCH

short_description: They See Us is a multiplayer horror game built for creepy vibes, scream-worthy jump scares and hilarious co-op tension. Work together to spot terrifying anomalies lurking in familiar places – before they find you!
name: They See Us

short_description: Backrooms: The Next Level is a Co-op horror game up to 4 players, where you and your friends will explore the game, try to pass the game level using your mind, wit, remembering the places where you were
name: Backrooms: The Next Level

short_description: Survive The Hunt is a Multiplayer Horror game (2 vs 16). Two players are the beasts and the remaining 14 will be scientists, prisoners or cops who will have to decide whether to cooperate or not to escape from the facility.
name: Survive The Hunt

short_description: A co-op horror game where you are part of a crew sheltering in a collapsed tunnel, scavenging loot across maps filled with deadly creatures born from a biological war. Feed the creature, convert its waste into fuel, and reach the radio tower
name: Holey

short_description: Enter the realm of the Dream Slayers, a Fantasy-Themed Extraction RPG where you battle nightmares, survive raids, and escape with powerful loot... or lose it all.
name: Dream Slayers

short_description: Send it your way in VMX. Ride BMX, MTB, or scooters, throw down gesture-based tricks, session parks with friends, take on challenges, and customize your ride and style in an immersive multiplayer VR playground.
name: VMX

short_description: Trapped in darkness, hunted down—your only way out is the right keycard. In this intense co-op multiplayer horror game, you and up to 4 friends must search terrifying maps, evade deadly villains, and escape before time runs out. No weapons, just wits. Can you survive?
name: Keycards

short_description: Guide a herd of sheep as a herding dog. Use timing and precision to navigate obstacles and complete each trial. Master the art of sheep herding and adapt to unpredictable animal behavior. Relaxing yet engaging, this game will test your skills and quick thinking in a unique and natural setting.
name: Atura

short_description: Ready to stop the bug infestation? Grab your wildest tools, go solo or team up with up to 4 players for chaotic missions, work together or totally troll the team! Bug cleaning has never been this fun and crazy!
name: Bug Cleaners

short_description: This is an idle-style casual game that appears at the bottom of your screen. In the game, you’ll hire adorable animals to work at the company you’ve founded. You be the boss and make sure they don’t slack off. The earnings can be used to renovate or expand your cozy office.
name: Furry Company

short_description: A punishing 2-4 player driving test of your relationships. Gramma can't see and you can't drive. Together, you'll navigate the world's worst detour in an ancient car that handles even worse than it looks.
name: Backseat Drivers

short_description: Control an awakened sword with your mouse cursor in this open-world RPG. Explore vast lands, uncover secrets, and battle fierce enemies. Gain new abilities, craft unique builds, and face bullet-hell-style combat as you grow stronger and defeat powerful foes!
name: The Sword's Awakening

short_description: Chains of Reality is a survival horror game focused on a story-driven single-player narrative, where you traverse a multitude of liminal environments and alternate dimensions in search of fulfilling your end of a deal, a deal made with someone you never should have trusted.
name: Chains of Reality

short_description: Hauntrick is a chaotic, goofy horror game where you hunt cursed objects, perform rituals, and survive bizarre hauntings—solo or with friends. The ghosts? Unpredictable, absurd, and hilariously annoying. Every match is a mix of strategy, panic, and laughter as reality itself starts to unravel.
name: Hauntrick

short_description: Play as an adorable office dog who overhears his owner's needs and decides to help! Grab items in your mouth, type on computers, complete silly tasks with pure dog logic across every floor of the office building.
name: Ruff Day at the Office

short_description: WardCorp is hiring. The pay is good. The dungeons are not. Co-op extraction roguelite, every contract hits different!
name: Gig Crawler

short_description: A first-person co-op horror game where you raid cursed buildings, grab what you can and get back to the train before it leaves. You need to sell enough loot to keep travelling. The Conductor makes sure you always owe more.
name: Dead Haul

short_description: Rockhounds is a 1-4 player extraction shooter where you and your squad brave the deadliest planets to extract minerals for ruthless Megacorps. Every mission is a fight for survival, wealth, and glory. Will you conquer the chaos and escape with your team? Gear up, and prove you’ve got what it takes!
name: Rockhounds

short_description: You owe the mafia a lot of money and your only way out is through high-stakes DURAK. Play your cards right, have the balls to cheat, or face consequences. In this MULTIPLAYER experience, you’ll gamble your life to clear your debt. But be warned! - losing means more than just an empty wallet.
name: The Biggest Fool: DURAK

short_description: A fast, chaotic top-down arena brawler in pixel art: grab pots and bombs and hurl them, fling your boomerang and grapple across the stage. Carry the princess to safety before your rivals do, play ball in Crownball or survive the waves. Online, local party or co-op.
name: DX Legends

short_description: Explore Hesperides Station in this co-op sci-horror social deduction game, where a Silicon Alien Lifeform prowls the halls. Work together with a team of seven to complete assignments and stop the lethal creature- or betray everyone in the name of Oroboros StarCorp.
name: Crew: Expendable

short_description: Hell Express is a PVE Co-op isometric shooter for 1-4 players. As a member of an armed delivery company operating between the living world and Limbo, you'll craft, loot, and fight to complete high-stakes deliveries—while uncovering the stories between life and death.
name: Hell Express

short_description: In this physics-based co-op platformer, you and a friend must carry your short-tempered king through deadly medieval courses. Dodge traps, maintain balance, and work together to reach the throne room. One wrong step, and the king might crown you with his rage!
name: Hold Your King

short_description: Galactic Pawns is an action-packed roguelite bullet hell, where you eliminate high-profile targets across war-torn planets. Master a vast arsenal, upgrade your abilities, and adapt to ever-changing battlefields in a fight for galactic order.
name: Galactic Pawns

short_description: You'll embark on a thrilling adventure, rolling your way through a dynamic open world, alone or with friends. Master the parkour to navigate these vast landscapes!
name: Orb Odyssey: Rolling Realms

short_description: Deadly Joy is a multiplayer horror game where Play Center employees must survive deadly missions. Cooperate or betray in challenges like Parkour, Basement, and Tower, while escaping terrifying mascots like Hugster and the CatBox.
name: Deadly Joy

short_description: Beast and Cleaver is an open-world adventure where players hunt and fight rare creatures. Master attack patterns, learn unique monster spawning mechanics, and expand the Hanging City to unlock new potions and customizations. Prepare for the hunt - filled with secrets, strategy, glory, and more!
name: Beast and Cleaver

short_description: A wacky, 4-player co-op party game set during the American Prohibition. Mix drinks, vet your patrons at the door, and keep the cops out of the know as you restore a faded speakeasy to its former glory.
name: Prohibition Panic!

short_description: MustScream is an online co-op horror game for 1-4 players that uses mic input. Scream into your mic to run! Push your voice to the limit and make it to the end!
name: MustScream

short_description: Duck Off! is a parkour game with optional single or multiplayer modes. In multiplayer, random events like Egg Fight, Ice Mode, and Banana Mode add chaos and comedy. With no checkpoints, every fall is a fresh struggle and troll, try to make your way to victory in this unpredictable duck adventure!
name: Duck Off!

short_description: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.
name: Chained Beasts

short_description: Catgirl! The RPG where you're a cat and also a girl. I bet you'd like that, wouldn't you? You little freak. Haha jk, ur good.
name: Catgirl

short_description: Build your ideal, cozy farm in a living village. Form bonds with fellow villagers to lend a hand as you grow crops, care for animals, and craft a corner of paradise. Sail across enchanted islands to discover new resources and adventures along the way.
name: Everdream Village

short_description: It’s literally raining cats and dogs. In this game you platform, overcome about 100 unique obstacles, fight 3 janky bosses, find comments added from YouTube Shorts and make it stop raining cats and dogs by fighting Jeff in the end. Here's a message from Jeff: "YOU WILL NEVER STOP ME YEEEHAWWW"
name: Raining Cats and Dogs

short_description: Paddle through pain. Solo or co-op. One paddle each. Lava everywhere. You’ll fall. You’ll scream. You might cry. Good luck and embrace the salt.
name: Paddle Paddle Paddle

short_description: Search the village of Naninani Mura to find answers about your past and evade the hauntingly beautiful 8 foot tall HachiShaku-sama!
name: Hachishaku

short_description: Online Co-op Cooking game with a twist: some of the chefs are secretly bloodthirsty killers! Play with up to 16 friends, and crack the case before your restaurant becomes… a GHOST KITCHEN
name: Ghost Kitchen

short_description: Your bond is your greatest weapon! Team up with a friend to battle monsters by answering quirky and thought-provoking questions about each other, while building decks and exploring an ever-changing world. Can your relationship survive the ultimate test?
name: Duo Quest

short_description: Enter a world of tactical mayhem, with dozens of unique weapons to obliterate your opponents, on an everchanging battlefield with destructible terrain! Manage your arsenal and unleash epic and game-changing combos, online and offline, solo or with friends, and become the greatest in the galaxy!
name: Galaxy Tactics

short_description: Zombie Dog is a zombie herding sheepdog game set in Yorkshire. It combines strategic coordination and timing with puzzle solving and comedic physics-based mayhem through its unique zombie herding mechanic.
name: Zombie Dog

short_description: Liberate your city from Zuck Corp in this 1-4 player co-op TPS with roguelite elements. Choose your arsenal of Gadgets, Buffs and cartoon weapons. Blast bots and skateboard as you regain your turf. Get stronger each zone on your way to beat the evil overlord MetaZuckBot! Ready to join the Rebellion?
name: My Pet Hooligan

short_description: Ascend through the twisted levels of the Backrooms using physics-based object manipulation to overcome obstacles, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover unsettling secrets. Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players as you climb higher, think smarter, and survive the unknown.
name: Climb The Backrooms

short_description: Backrooms Escape Protocol is a multiplayer horror game where you and your friends explore eerie backrooms, evade terrifying entities, and uncover hidden secrets. Work together to survive the endless maze and escape before it's too late!
name: Backrooms Escape Protocol

short_description: An online co-op action RPG for up to 8 players. Raid fully physics-based gigantic beasts, climb onto them to smash their heads, and experience full-physics intense next-gen action battles with your party.
name: Beast Siege

short_description: Dreadline: Net Quota is a chaotic co-op game for up to 6 players set on dangerous seas. Catch fish with different rods or spearfishing, keep your boat afloat as systems fail, and survive unpredictable encounters without drowning as everything falls apart.
name: Dreadline: Net Quota

short_description: Enter high-risk extraction zones, plant containment bombs, and evacuate before the area is wiped out along with you and your team. Every decision matters. Death is permanent. A hardcore 6-player cooperative horror experience where survival is never guaranteed.
name: PATIENT ZERO

short_description: Chaotic co-op for 1–4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time. Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!
name: Loco: Rails & Tails

short_description: Run your own restaurant in the snowy Alaskan town of Northpointis Bay and experience an immersive fishing and restaurant simulator. Catch fish in first-person, manage your restaurant, cook and sell your catch, and become the town’s top angler and restaurateur.
name: Northern Waters - Fishing & Restaurant Simulator

short_description: 40 Doors 40 Mistakes is an anomaly-spotting game for up to 4 players. Walk through 40 unsettling rooms. Spot what’s wrong, capture it, and keep going—unless you miss one.
name: Shout Out!

short_description: Welcome to Clayground—the next-gen multiplayer VR experience where imagination knows no bounds! Whether you're a VR veteran or stepping into virtual reality for the first time, Clayground invites you to a playground like no other.
name: Clayground

short_description: As the last pilot aboard the dice-shaped combat machine [ Dice-Rover ], destroy threatening objects with exhilarating action. Power up your Dice-Rover enough to find and destroy the ultimate target, [ JAIL DICE ].
name: JAIL DICE: Roll to Break

short_description: Finding Ivy is a cute casual 2D platformer where 1-4 players make their way through a kid-drawn world to win back their runaway cat. Run, jump, climb, and discover items and friends that help you along the way!
name: Finding Ivy

short_description: This is a casual 3rd person shooter game that includes shooter combat mechanics for the playable humanoid, mech and tank. Explore the open world, chat with the quirky inhabitants, and shoot down the monstrous creatures and dangerous rogue robots wandering around the island.
name: What's Needed

short_description: Arthur is in a panic! He was watching pets and suddenly, they have all escaped! Run, jump, and race through Elwood City to help him bring the animals back home!
name: Arthur's Pet Chase

short_description: Cart Capers is a light-hearted physics game where you ride through strange dream-like levels — without ever stepping off your cart.
name: Cart Capers

short_description: Terrible Life Expectancy is a roguelite top-down shooter with Survivors elements. Fight absurd hordes of mutants for the amusement of an unseen bloodthirsty audience and only inherit all your upgrades as long as someone in your family is still breathing... or at least twitching.
name: Terrible Life Expectancy

short_description: Build your own settlement and create your own dynasty in the Medieval world. Lush and harsh forests, enemy guards, allied cities and trade, resource extraction, crafting and construction - all the tools are in your hands. Play alone or with friends to conquer the vastness of this unimaginable world.
name: Medieval Contrast

short_description: A lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Foul creatures roam the halls - and management still expects YOU to mop the floor. Even though the floor ate Gary. Welcome to the Night Crew. You are 𝙙𝙚𝙛𝙞𝙣𝙞𝙩𝙚𝙡𝙮 not paid enough for this.
name: Night Crew

short_description: Time to clock in at DE NILE SHIPPING, the world’s “most efficient” warehouse! Work together in online co-op with up to 4 players to fulfill orders of increasingly chaotic, physics-based boxes. Time is money, and safety is no concern… just try not to crash out!
name: Crashout Crew

short_description: Mycelium: The Silent Contract is a co-op/single player extraction horror set in a haunted liminal forest. Your contract is simple: get mycelium and extract. But in this forest, nothing is what it seems. So what did you sign, exactly?
name: Mycelium: The Silent Contract

short_description: Off the Shelf! is a hilarious physics-based romp made for maximum chaos! Launch a free ragdoll character into a frantic rush, knocking objects off shelves to rack up points. Master the art of Shelf Surfing as you jump, dash, and smash your way to a high score!
name: Off the Shelf!

short_description: Chop the sick trees to purify the forests. Gather lumber, upgrade your axe, and improve stats. No rush, no stress, relax in cozy and beautiful lands, rescue animals, and unravel the secrets of the wilderness. Nature must be preserved so cut the shadow and restore the light!
name: Dreamcraft: Lumberjack

short_description: An aiming-based action game featuring "one-shot tension." Bounce the ball with your shots in a cylindrical space to reach the top. Fall and start over. Only your skills matter.
name: Touch the Sky

short_description: Backrooms: The Others is a cooperative horror game for up to 4 players where you will be forced to explore these unknown nooks and crannies, trying to survive in this complex world where death can be waiting for you at every turn!
name: Backrooms: The Others

short_description: KUNKUN Defender 2 is a hybrid TPS and tower defense game where players must fend off waves of zombies in virus-infected zones, holding their ground until a helicopter arrives for extraction.
name: KUNKUN Defender 2

short_description: STEAL THE PIG! is a cooperative game where two thieves must steal a stubborn pig and deliver it safely while overcoming traps and puzzles. Play with a friend in multiplayer, choose your difficulty level, and make sure the pig doesn’t escape!
name: Steal The Pig

short_description: 100 years after a nuclear apocalypse, an AI-managed shelter and its guardian mechs await human survivors. The shelter’s reactor creates safe zones to improve living conditions. Players control mechs to gather reactor fuel, fend off mutants, complete missions, and protect survivors.
name: Iron Core: Mech Survivor

short_description: Collect over 100 stylish little pets on your desktop! They can freely move along the bottom of your screen, or live in the little houses you've carefully decorated for them. Hmm... or perhaps send them on adventures to earn treats?
name: Desk Paws

short_description: Grab your helmet and fire up the engines! This is raw construction - sweat, smoke, and steel. Operate cranes, loaders, rollers, and more as you and your CREW carve terrain, raise structures, and pour asphalt to finish the toughest jobs together.
name: Construction Crew

short_description: A horror pvp/co-op shooter for 2-4 players inspired by the early 2000's era of videogames. Your friend texted you after discovering that the long-closed servers for a videogame you used to play as a child have reopened. But something was waiting for you.
name: HEARTDUST

short_description: Trapped in a secret sleep experiment, you and your friends must survive terrifying nightmares, completing tasks to wake up before it's too late. Play solo or in co-op, but beware the experiments are never the same and something watches from the dark.
name: Dream Eaters.exe

short_description: PARTY Basketball! is a multiplayer eSports basketball video game. Team up with your friends or play against them in a variety of basketball games. Showing the world who has the best shot won't be easy because, as real basketball, you really need good hands to let the ball go in.
name: PARTY Basketball!

short_description: Help Buddy and Lucky develop their sports photos! Paint each character, color by color, pixel by pixel, in a relaxing experience full of friendship, fun, and sports!
name: Coloring Cats: Sports With Friends

short_description: Backrooms: The Deep Dark is a 4-player cooperative horror game where you will survive in a mysterious scary atmospheric world, wander through unknown dark corners and get scared of every nook and cranny!
name: Backrooms: The Deep Dark

short_description: Welcome to a sinful night with the galaxy’s wackiest aliens. Play twisted tabletop games with up to 4 players, devise brilliant strategies, bluff your way to victory, and try not to lose your head - literally.
name: Bogos Binted?

short_description: Congratulations on your new career at B.A.N.K.! Go it alone or with friends (1-4) — serve customers, uphold the bank's reputation, climb the corporate ladder, and find success in your work. It's all up to you!
name: B.A.N.K.

short_description: Ball & Roll is a physics-based platform game that you can play solo or with friends! Control your cute animal inside a rolling ball, overcome challenging obstacles, move fast, and reach the top as quickly as possible. But be careful... One mistake can send you all the way back to the start!
name: Ball & Roll

short_description: Online co-op party game for up to 4 players. Drive a garbage truck through a colorful cartoon city, hang off the back, and sort recyclable, organic and glass into the right compartment. The faster your crew cleans every block, the more stars you earn.
name: Trash Party

short_description: A social deduction party game for 4-10 friends in a 1927 speakeasy. Regulars play the bar's games, find the body and vote out the killer. The killer stabs in secret, hides the body, mops the blood and blames someone else.
name: Bar of Betrayal

short_description: Breaking the Grip is a multiplayer horror and strategy game. As a survivor, complete a ritual to eliminate the spirit before it drives you insane. As the spirit, spread terror and break their will. Who will prevail between life and the beyond?
name: Breaking the Grip

short_description: Backrooms: The Scream is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players, where you can play as a single player, but what could be better than hearing your friend scream in the game? This is an unforgettable experience you will get with your friends!
name: Backrooms: The Scream

short_description: The Liminal Library is a horror game based on liminal spaces where players solve puzzles, uncover many things hidden within the liminal spaces. The Liminal Library works on exploration as well as puzzles based mechanics to find your way out along with other rules you must follow for survival.
name: The Liminal Library

short_description: GalactiBus is an online co-op bus-driving simulator set in a wacky alien world. Team up as up to 4 players with friends or strangers. Keep the bus running, deliver your passengers “safely” and eliminate all threats along the way on this cosmic journey doomed to be disastrous.
name: GalactiBus

short_description: You must escape the town, while trying to beat 2 clocks. An incoming nuke, and a viral infection. Can you make it out in time?
name: The Town That Died In The Night

short_description: “Run Chicken Run” is an online co-op action and simple entertainment game.In the game you and your allies have to chase the chicken to catch the one that escaped from the table. You have to get the chicken to the restaurant and deliver it to the cook before it escapes from the garden.
name: Run Chicken Run

short_description: A 3D marble rolling game where you're chained to your friends! Play solo or co-op, and roll your way through 80+ stages!
name: Chain-Chillas

short_description: Food fights hit the streets! Battle Food Mania is a fast-paced, action game packed with humor and chaos. Play as pizza, cupcakes, bottles and more as you battle to deliver the box - or stop the delivery! Run, shoot and blast your rivals in wild food wars, play solo or with friends.
name: Battle Food Mania

short_description: Open the portal with your teammates to defeat enemies. Use each character’s unique abilities to apply the right tactics, stop enemies, and repair the generator to activate the portal.
name: Forgotten Signal: Portal

short_description: Pirate Gambit is a 4-player tactical, bluffing card game. Each player uses strategy and wit to outsmart their opponents. Form alliances, make moves carefully, and bluff your way to victory! Battle to become the ruler of the high seas!
name: Pirate's Gambit

short_description: Team up with friends as a melee enjoyer or use unethical ranged abilities to fight the alien menace in this Sci-fi meets Fantasy MMORPG. That's right.. SCI-FI MMORPG!! Explore the planet of Rixa using a unique NanoBot ability system and a host of weapons at your disposal. For the Queen!!!!
name: Rixa

short_description: Become an internet star in Capy Stream: Rise to Fame by playing as a cute, fluffy streamer! Soak in a hot bath, groom your fur, and set up your studio around the capybara to gain fame!
name: Capy Stream: Rise to Fame

short_description: Lootworld is an online extraction game with roguelike, PvPvE, and looting elements. Enter dangerous dungeons, fight monsters and rival players, and extract with valuable treasures. Team up to strategize, secure powerful gear, and dominate the battlefield—if you can make it out alive.
name: Lootworld

short_description: Hamspater is a simple side-scrolling roguelike game that requires control. To keep your hamster alive and attack effectively, you must focus on movement control. Defeat slimes and survive for 20 minutes to get more gold.
name: Hamspater

short_description: This is an exhilarating bullet-hell shooting game.
name: Warbot Engineer

short_description: Piece together stunning images of nature’s fiercest rivals in "Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle"! Solve puzzles featuring powerful bears and cunning wolves in breathtaking landscapes. With 30 to 285 pieces, enjoy a relaxing, immersive experience perfect for wildlife and puzzle lovers alike!
name: Bear vs. Wolf Jigsaw Puzzle

short_description: <oiia> is the ultimate meme game featuring a cozy single player desktop pet mode and a challenging 4 player party mode. You can also use the Steam Workshop to create your own friendly talking companion.
name: oiia

short_description: Dominate your friends in chaotic minigames and on dynamic game boards in 4-8 player online/local multiplayer. Throw dice to smash opponents, hit targets for bonuses, and activate influential board events. Collect Items and Cards in a combative twist on the board game formula.
name: Party Champ

short_description: A cozy jigsaw game with a twist; every piece is the same shape, but not the same size! A low-pressure experience with chill piano music and gorgeous hand-drawn line art.
name: Squarepinski

short_description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!
name: Clear the Snow

short_description: Play real casino craps in 3D and enjoy realistic physics and multiplayer mode. Feel the thrill of competition, immerse yourself in the casino atmosphere and try your luck!
name: Vegas Craps by Pokerist

short_description: Enjoy the trill of vehicle simulation in this open-world transport RPG game.
name: Rise Of Transport

short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.
name: Whisk

short_description: Build your own paradise on the Miami coast! Run a beach bar solo or with up to 6 friends in co-op. Expand your pier freely, master realistic mixology, and keep rowdy crowds under control. In this sun-drenched simulator, every drink you mix shapes your success.
name: Beach Bar Simulator

short_description: Death Kitchen is a fast-paced online co-op horror cooking game. Decide between a chef and a waiter, then coordinate with your friends to serve alien customers who can kill you if you make a mistake. Embrace the chaos and deliver quality with your new intergalactic restaurant chain.
name: Death Kitchen

short_description: We fused co-op strategy, deckbuilding, and restaurant chaos into the ultimate roguelike dining experience! Build your deck, serve customers, master the kitchen, and secure your place amongst the Hall of Taste!
name: Dining Deck

short_description: Experience the thrill of a Japanese festival with a unique twist! This online co-op game combines the fun of "Ball Scooping" (like goldfish scooping, but with balls!) and "Shooting Gallery" games.
name: Ball Scooping Friends

short_description: Liminality sets in the near future, where humanity discovers a liminal hell full with anomalies, explore multiple unique levels with increasing difficulty and teamwork, good luck on your next expedition.
name: Liminality

short_description: A co-op friendslop game with a heavy focus on customization via drawing. Scavenge liminal bunkers and obtain artefacts that may or may not aid you and your friends.
name: Whimsical Artefacts

short_description: SLAMPUNKS is a 1-3 player co-op hero-based survivors-like. You're an unhinged rebel sabotaging the corp draining the planet dry. Pick a hero, tether your friend, and use them to steamroll the swarm. Stack game-breaking augments until they beg for mercy. Bullet heaven, where your buddy is the weapon.
name: SLAMPUNKS
